# clavis prompt

<p class="cli-lead">Print the linked project and environment for your shell prompt</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis prompt [flags]
```

</div>

Print the linked project and environment as a short word, such as
`web:dev`, for your shell prompt. Production environments print as
`web:PRODUCTION!` so a risky terminal stands out. It reads only
`.clavis.yaml`, never calls the server, and prints nothing outside a
linked folder, so it is fast enough to run on every prompt.

`--shell bash`, `zsh` or `fish` prints the lines to add to your startup
file.

## Examples

```sh
clavis prompt
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Set up zsh</p>

```sh
clavis prompt --shell zsh
```
